title: Aloha Shores | KEY.co
description_expanded: This home includes FREE Hilton Waikoloa Village Resort passes in 2026. The Hilton Waikoloa Village Resort was voted the #1 resort in Hawaii by USA Today. Normally, resort passes cost $100/adult and $60/child, but when staying at this home, use for up to 10 people is COMPLIMENTARY with no additional cost each and every day of your stay. This includes use of resort pools, the river pool, waterslides, hot tub, a saltwater lagoon for snorkeling, lounge chairs, towels, and parking validation for one vehicle. It also includes a 10% discount on Spa Treatments, 10% discount on Lagoon toys, and Cabana rentals. Guests love this resort pass which gives them the best of both worlds with hotel privileges and a comfortable, well-equipped vacation home. The open-concept main floor seamlessly blends indoor and outdoor living, with a fully equipped kitchen, dining area, and great room that flows onto a large lanai. Perfect for entertaining, the dining arrangements can comfortably seat twelve people, with additional seating for four at the kitchen island. Relax in the living room, featuring a new 70" UltraHD 4K TV and sound bar, or retreat to one of the bedrooms, each equipped with its own TV. Outside, the lanai offers a private grill, outdoor living room, and dining area, creating the perfect space for enjoying the Hawaiian breeze. Unwind in the private spa or pool, and don't miss the breathtaking sunsets that complete this idyllic setting.
